# Obtain business licenses and operating permits

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

Before starting an activity or opening a location that may require permission. A jurisdiction-and-activity register showing issued permissions, unresolved restrictions and renewal owners.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. List activities, products and operating locations

agent-runnable


Describe what the business actually does, where staff and customers are located, the premises used and any regulated products. Include online and physical activities so a company registration is not mistaken for an activity permit.

- Sources: [SBA launch your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/launch-your-business/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Determine the competent authorities and requirements

human · human approval required


Have a qualified local adviser identify the relevant licensing bodies and assess exemptions, prerequisites and restrictions. Record the authority source and current requirements for the actual activity; leave uncertain permissions unresolved.

- Sources: [SBA launch your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/launch-your-business/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare a permission-by-permission application pack

agent-runnable


Assemble the required entity, premises, personnel, insurance and product evidence from verified records. Track missing documents and dependencies without inventing qualifications, approvals or eligibility.

- Sources: [SBA launch your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/launch-your-business/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Submit the approved applications and track decisions

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


The authorized applicant reviews the final declarations and fees, submits through the authority channel and retains receipts. Respond to requests through the assigned owner and keep the restricted activity paused while a required permission is pending.

- Sources: [SBA launch your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/launch-your-business/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Release permitted activities and calendar renewals

human · human approval required


Check the issued license scope, conditions, location and expiry against the intended operation. Assign renewal and change-notification owners and retain evidence of the decision to start each permitted activity.

- Verify: A jurisdiction-and-activity register showing issued permissions, unresolved restrictions and renewal owners.
- Sources: [SBA launch your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/launch-your-business/)
